# SEO Experts Denver

> One-to-one SEO expert help for Denver and Colorado businesses: expert SEO audits reviewed by a person, diagnosis of traffic drops, Google update hits, manual actions, failed site migrations, suspended Google Business Profiles and missing AI Overviews citations, plus consulting and coaching. Operated by Eye To Ad Media, a Denver marketing company in business since 2012.

Key facts:
- Operator: Eye To Ad Media, Denver, Colorado (https://eyetoad.com/). Founder Zach Wennstedt works directly on client accounts.
- Phone: 1-800-481-8638. Contact form: https://seoexpertsdenver.com/contact/ (no email address is published).
- Area served: Denver and the rest of Colorado.
- Pricing: the first look and the free diagnosis carry no contract; project work gets a fixed written quote before it starts. No guaranteed rankings.
- Free self-serve tool: https://seoexpertsdenver.com/seo-problem-diagnosis/ (eight questions, returns a likely cause and what to check first).

## Problems we diagnose and fix

- [Traffic Drop Recovery: Denver SEO Expert Diagnosis](https://seoexpertsdenver.com/traffic-drop-recovery/): Organic traffic fell? A Denver SEO expert separates real ranking losses from tracking errors, seasonality, updates and site changes, then fixes the cause.
- [Google Core Update Recovery: Denver SEO Expert Help](https://seoexpertsdenver.com/google-update-recovery/): Hit by a Google core update or spam update? How a Denver SEO expert confirms the cause, assesses content honestly and plans a realistic recovery.
- [Google Manual Action Removal: Denver SEO Expert](https://seoexpertsdenver.com/google-penalty-removal/): Got a manual action in Google Search Console? How a Denver SEO expert finds the violation, cleans it up and writes a reconsideration request that holds up.
- [Rankings Dropped After a Redesign? Migration Rescue](https://seoexpertsdenver.com/site-migration-rescue/): Rankings fell after a redesign, platform switch or domain change? An expert maps what was lost, repairs redirects and signals, and plans recovery.
- [Google Business Profile Suspended? Denver Expert Help](https://seoexpertsdenver.com/google-business-profile-suspended/): Business Profile suspended or disabled? What usually triggers it, what to fix before appealing, the evidence Google accepts, and how the appeal works.
- [Not in AI Overviews? Why Competitors Get Cited](https://seoexpertsdenver.com/ai-overviews-visibility/): Why AI Overviews cite competitors instead of you, what Google says actually governs inclusion, and how an expert diagnoses lost clicks from AI answers.
- [Free SEO Problem Diagnosis Quiz | SEO Experts Denver](https://seoexpertsdenver.com/seo-problem-diagnosis/): Answer eight questions about your traffic, site changes and Google reports to get a likely cause, what to check first, and where to get expert help.
